title: Europs
summary: Europs is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), column Kings of Sicyon , by a yeere of the World. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: Calculated from printed figures. No tier 1–4 birth, no tier reign start, and no provisional year. Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 1988. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 1988 = 2045 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad. A printed year for this person would replace it.

calculated.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 782b

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 782b
reign.note: Year cell "2670 1988 331". The third printed figure 331 is the column "Floud", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 45 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Kings of Sicyon ..
